instruction.text: Do you know what a body of water is? Select the correct answer.

b.sound: A large amount of water, like a sea or ocean.
A magical mermaid that is made out of water.

instruction.text: The UK is an island, which means we are surrounded by sea. Select the images of the UK’s seaside.

feedback.end: The UK is surrounded by the North Sea, the Irish Sea, the Celtic Sea and the English Channel. They are all part of the Atlantic Ocean.

instruction.text: This map shows the bodies of water around the UK. Answer the questions using the map.

atoms.a: Which body of water is to the east of the UK?

hint.text: Look at the compass in the top left corner. The letter E means east.

feedback.end: The North Sea separates England and Scotland from Norway and Denmark.

atoms.a: Is the English Channel to the north or south of England?

hint.text: Look at the compass in the top left corner. The letter S means south.

feedback.end: France is just across the English Channel. We can cross over on a ferry or take a train underneath through the Channel Tunnel.

atoms.a: Which sea would someone in Wales have to cross to get to Northern Ireland?

feedback.end: The Irish Sea separates Northern Ireland from the rest of the UK.

atoms.a: Which sea is to the south-west of the UK?

hint.text: Look at the compass in the top left corner. The letter S means south, and the letter W means west. South-west is inbetween.

feedback.end: The Celtic Sea opens out into the Atlantic Ocean.

instruction.text: Can you remember where the English Channel is? Drag the label to the correct place on the map.

hint.text: The only UK country it borders is England.

instruction.text: Can you remember where the Irish Sea is? Drag the label to the correct place on the map.

hint.text: You cross over this sea to get to Northern Ireland from England.

instruction.text: Can you remember where the North Sea is? Drag the label to the correct place on the map.

hint.text: This sea stretches between two UK countries and two European countries.

instruction.text: Can you remember where the Celtic Sea is? Drag the label to the correct place on the map.

hint.text: This sea is the furthest away from Scotland.
